# Internal Search - PRD

## Product

A staff-only search box across the org's internal wiki, ticket system, and shared drive. One query, three sources, one result list.

## Users

- Any staff member with a company sign-in.
- No external users.

## Requirements (initial draft)

### REQ-001 - Federated search over three sources

- Query fans out to the wiki API, the ticket API, and the drive API in parallel.
- Each source returns up to twenty hits with title, snippet, source id, and permission-filtered visibility.
- The result page shows hits interleaved by relevance and grouped by source.

### REQ-002 - Company sign-in required

- All routes are behind the corporate SSO provider (OpenID Connect).
- The sign-in page is corporate-branded; sign-out returns to the corporate portal.
- Session cookies expire after eight hours of inactivity.

### REQ-003 - Zero-result telemetry

- When a query returns zero hits across all sources, an event is written to the observability pipeline with the query text redacted to counts and length.
- Weekly digest of zero-result queries goes to the search-owner via email.

## Out of scope for v1

- Public search or unauthenticated access.
- Result personalisation.
- Query autocomplete.

## Non-functional constraints

- P95 query latency under one second at ten queries per second.
- Zero user data leaves the corporate boundary.
